basic_details.job_title: BSA Kushinagar Technical Instructor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 21 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Kushinagar (Jila Basic Shiksha Adhikari, Kushinagar) has invited applications for 21 Technical Instructor (Takniki Anudeshak) posts in three trades. Selection is on an outsourcing basis through the service provider Struggle Life Solution Pvt. Ltd., Lucknow, at an honorarium of Rs. 10450 per month (including subscriber contribution). Candidates need an ITI certificate in a listed trade or B.Sc. Agriculture, depending on the post, and must be 21 to 40 years old. Applications are made online at sewayojan.up.nic.in until 12.00 midnight on 27 Nove

age_limit.details: The age limit for all three posts is 21–40 years: a minimum of 21 years on 01 July 2023 and a maximum of 40 years on the last date of application. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. | Candidates should check the official notification for the trade-specific eligibility of each post.

qualification.details: Post Essential Qualification Technical Instructor (Engineering and Workshop Trade) Certificate in any 01 trade from a Government recognised Industrial Training Institute (ITI), from the trades listed below Technical Instructor (Energy and Environment Trade) Certificate in any 01 trade from a Government recognised Industrial Training Institute (ITI), from the trades listed below Technical Instructor (Agriculture, Nursery and Gardening) B.Sc. Agriculture | Trades accepted for Technical Instructor (Engineering and Workshop Trade): | Construction and Woodworking Fabrication (Fitting and Welding) Fitter General Carpenter Plumber Sheet Metal Worker Painter | Trades accepted for Technical Instructor (Energy and Environment Trade): | Electrical Electrician Electronics Electronics Mechanic

how_to_apply: Interested candidates apply online on the Sewayojan portal at https://sewayojan.up.nic.in/. The last date to apply is 27 November 2026, up to 12.00 midnight. The notice does not list any documents to upload or attach.

content_sections.heading: About BSA Kushinagar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice comes from the Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Kushinagar, the district's basic education office in Uttar Pradesh, and is signed by District Basic Education Officer Anil Kumar Singh. It is issued in compliance with letter No. एल०बी०डी० अनुदेशक-2/5313/2024-25 dated 09 September 2024 of the Director General, School Education and State Project Director, Samagra Shiksha, Uttar Pradesh, Lucknow. The selected Technical Instructors are not engaged directly by the department. Selection is made on an outsourcing basis through the service provider Struggle Life Solution Pvt. Ltd., Lucknow.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The 21 Technical Instructor vacancies are divided among three trades as follows. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Trades accepted for Technical Instructor (Engineering and Workshop Trade): Construction and Woodworking Fabrication (Fitting and Welding) Fitter General Carpenter Plumber Sheet Metal Worker Painter Trades accepted for Technical Instructor (Energy and Environment Trade): Electrical Electrician Electronics Electronics Mechanic The age limit for all three posts is 21–40 years: a minimum of 21 years on 01 July 2023 and a maximum of 40 years on the last date of application. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the trade-specific eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BSA Kushinagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 21 Technical Instructor vacancies: 06 in Engineering and Workshop Trade, 09 in Energy and Environment Trade and 06 in Agriculture, Nursery and Gardening.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Kushinagar Technical Instructor posts?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 27 November 2026, up to 12.00 midnight.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for Technical Instructor (Engineering and Workshop Trade) and (Energy and Environment Trade)?
faq.answer: Both posts need a certificate in any 01 listed trade from a Government recognised ITI. Engineering and Workshop Trade accepts trades such as Fitter, Plumber and General Carpenter, and Energy and Environment Trade accepts Electrical, Electrician, Electronics or Electronics Mechanic.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for Technical Instructor (Agriculture, Nursery and Gardening)?
faq.answer: The Technical Instructor (Agriculture, Nursery and Gardening) post requires B.Sc. Agriculture.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Kushinagar Technical Instructor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21–40 years: minimum 21 years on 01 July 2023 and maximum 40 years on the last date of application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a Technical Instructor in BSA Kushinagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The honorarium is Rs. 10450/- per month, including subscriber contribution, for all three posts.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for BSA Kushinagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are made online at https://sewayojan.up.nic.in/ by 12.00 midnight on 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Are these Technical Instructor posts direct government appointments?
faq.answer: No. The notice says selection is on an outsourcing basis through the service provider Struggle Life Solution Pvt. Ltd., Lucknow.
